supersedes: v1/v2 retained; v3 enforces original45s deadline in actual controller loop, fails unconfirmed reader/reap/cleanup, blocks later cases
runWorkingDirectory: unchanged checksum-pinned v1.59.0 source root after exact flat driver extraction to test/nativeproof

environment.SLICCY_RUNNER_OS_VERSION: actual sw_vers -productVersion, independently rechecked by driver; major27

environmentExclusions: no inherited download credentials in app/CLI; explicit isolated child HOME/TMPDIR and telemetry/update off

schemas.driver: schema1 capture-suite.json plus per-case driver-observations.json, milestones.ndjson, stderr.txt and frame-NNN.jpeg
schemas.partialRecords: bounded first-byte/completion/reset facts and byte count; incomplete records are never decoded/admitted

observerDecision.identity: independent kernel parent/UID/incarnation/running CPU+CodeDirectory hash, strict live+static signed role, actual fixed Chrome profile argv; CG owner PID and unique bounds
observerDecision.windowIdentification: helper and Chrome use independently selected frozen geometry by verified owner PID; app requires fixed indicator plus every independently visible owner window; actual Apple authorization owner uses independently observed new unique windows/bounds
observerDecision.subtree: strict root-PID subset of verified owned subtree, matching the signed fixture; unknown child/shim/window owner fails-to-demonstrate; no guessed role
observerDecision.titles: optional sealed diagnostics only; absent, unavailable or conflicting title does not change verdict
observerDecision.observerAccess: actual read-only CGPreflightScreenCaptureAccess result retained; responsible PID remains unknown unless established; no permission inference from ancestry
observerDecision.missingOrAmbiguousPIDBounds: FAILED_TO_DEMONSTRATE; no fallback grant, prompt or title-based selection

sourceAssertions.fixedPages: four exact loopback paths/geometry plus successful GETs; no join capability in Chrome argv
sourceAssertions.color: positive four-quadrant/pulse pattern sRGB tolerance8 and pulse tolerance16; both pulse phases required
sourceAssertions.displayMask: all decoded pixels outside an8-point helper halo must be black within12/255; each protected rectangle needs independently positioned omission samples; no widening after run
sourceAssertions.protection: every protected owner requires actual unconfounded display refusal and every actual window its own builder refusal; nonzero-layer windows are separately marked confounded
sourceAssertions.provenance: no protected-origin pixel guarantee; fixed synthetic source only

stopAssertions.eventClock: app eventElapsedMs, not emission order; native/source admission after invalidation fails
stopAssertions.wireClock: local case uses causal lower clock bound from actual baseline marker round trip; reciprocal case starts at actual viewer request, not later app receipt
stopAssertions.receiver: instant policy clear independent of JPEG decode; source/native timestamps, record arrival, decode/admission times and reset facts separate; no admission after reset; already-in-flight records explicitly discarded
stopAssertions.reverse: actual receive/enqueue/write ordinals plus final synchronized cutoff; pending-at-cutoff/in-flight/invalid/unsettled evidence cannot pass; peer Stop OPENED+END required for reciprocal

limits.nativeAPICalls: read-only local calls; any case over45s fails; outer450s driver/470s test bounds cover hung APIs

cleanup: actual app Wait; exact monitored owned PID/incarnation only for emergency signals, never authorization service; direct signed-app reaps retained, short-lived secondary reap claims labelled supporting; verify known children absent, owned roots removed, known windows absent and no readable root-associated app/Chrome processes; unconfirmed cleanup prevents further native cases
sealing: all private output including every complete JPEG record, stderr, source maps and case outcomes must be sealed to existing public age recipient before upload; no raw failure cat/public logs; no private key in job

validation.validationScope: generated pixels, pure metadata/filesystem/net.Pipe and genuine loopback Pion only; actual Darwin identity/GUI branches compiled but unrun

remainingReviewGates: exact sealed hosted wrapper/workflow source and artifact binding review
one explicitly authorized capture-only dispatch; no automatic retry
coverageLimitations: actual authorization fixture cannot stand in for other classes
preexisting image TCC entries are not treated as observer grants
priorOutcomesAndArtifacts: all earlier PASS/FAIL/FAILED_TO_DEMONSTRATE records and signed fixtures preserved
